We have average fuel consumption 8.2L/100km. Convert to mpg. 8.2 L per 100 km. 1 mile = 1.609 km. 100 km = 62.137 miles. So consumption per 62.137 miles is 8.2 L. 1 gallon = 3.785 L. So 8.2 L = 2.165 gallons per 62.137 miles. So mpg = 62.137 / 2.165 = 28.7 mpg. So with 10 gallons, range ~287 miles. So cannot cover 750 miles. So need to fill. We can fill fuel tank. Use fillFuelTank. But we need to decide how much to fill. We can fill up to 50 gallons. We have 10 gallons currently. So we could fill 40 gallons. But maybe just fill to full. Let's fill 40 gallons.")
